channel.title: Catalyst: The Awakening — Issues
channel.description: Lagos noir comic universe rooted in Yoruba mythology. Four free issues — read them page by page.

item.title: Issue #04 — The Chosen Four (Arc I Finale)
item.description: All four chosen — Bayo, Amara, Ikenna, and Zara — converge at the Balogun Nexus as the Ọ̀run tears open above Lagos Island. The Architect reveals his face for the first time. Arc I ends not with a victory, but with a choice.

item.title: Issue #03 — Iron in the Blood
item.description: In the Mushin mechanic workshop where Ikenna apprentices, the iron comes alive. Ògún has been waiting in every welding rod, every car chassis, every nail. When the Pale Council strikes, the metal strikes back.

item.title: Issue #02 — Ṣàngó's Daughter
item.description: Amara Okafor busks her talking drum outside the National Theatre when Ṣàngó's storm-spirit tears through Lagos. Her ancestral gift ignites in one thunderclap — but power without control is a danfo with no brakes on the expressway.

item.title: Issue #01 — Awaken, O City
item.description: Bayo is 19, broke, and ducking landlord wahala when the city itself reaches out and grabs him by the soul. One danfo ride across the Third Mainland Bridge changes everything. The Ọ̀run is bleeding, and he is the bandage — or the wound.
